explain.title: Good to know
explain.stars: Stars: each level gives up to 3 stars. With 2 stars (usually 80% right) it is passed and the next level opens. 3 stars mean everything was right on the first try.
explain.mastery: Confidence: how solid a skill is, worked out from the rounds played. Recent rounds count more. Below 60% it still needs practice.
explain.review: Review: what was learned comes back at growing intervals so it sticks. In “Practice” mode, what is due comes first.
explain.noStreaks: There are no streaks, and nothing is lost when a day is skipped.

stored.title: What we store
stored.text: For the parent account: email address, a hashed password, language and theme. To keep you signed in we only set strictly necessary cookies.

kids.title: Kids’ data
kids.text: A kid profile only holds a nickname, a drawn avatar, the starting level or birth year, settings and learning progress. Real names are not needed.

noPhotos.title: No photos, no recordings
noPhotos.text: {{brand}} never asks for photos, the camera or the microphone.

noTrackers.title: No trackers
noTrackers.text: No ads, no analytics, no fonts or scripts from other servers. Everything runs on this server.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We only use session cookies for signing in, the parent area and the active kid profile. That is why there is no cookie banner.

rights.title: Download and delete
rights.text: In the parent area you can download all data at any time or delete your account with all kid profiles for good (nFADP, GDPR).

purpose.title: What {{brand}} is for
purpose.text: {{brand}} is a learning app for kids from kindergarten to the end of 2nd grade, aligned with Lehrplan 21.

accounts.title: Parent account
accounts.text: An adult parent or legal guardian opens the account and is responsible for the kid profiles.

kids.title: Kids
kids.text: Kids only use {{brand}} through a profile in the parent account. They do not need their own email address.

content.title: Content
content.text: The exercises may be used for your own learning. Redistribution or resale is not allowed.

liability.title: Liability
liability.text: We do our best to make everything correct and working, but cannot guarantee it.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: If these terms change, we will let you know by email.

operator.title: Responsible and contact
operator.none: Run by the person or organization hosting this instance. Please contact them with any questions.

offline.banner: No internet connection. Changes are only saved once the connection is back.

what.title: What is {{brand}}?
what.text: {{brand}} is a learning app for kids from kindergarten to the end of 2nd grade: math, reading and writing, in Swiss German and American English. No ads, no trackers and no streaks that put on pressure.

curriculum.title: Lehrplan 21
curriculum.text: The content is aligned with the Swiss Lehrplan 21 (cycle 1). {{brand}} is not affiliated with or endorsed by Lehrplan 21 or its publishers.

voices.title: The voices
voices.text: The voices are generated with artificial intelligence (Qwen3-TTS). They were recorded once in advance and are stored on this server. Nothing is generated live while playing, and none of your kid’s data is used for it.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: Everything runs on this server: no fonts, scripts or pictures from other servers. The privacy page has the details.

credits.title: Credits and licenses
credits.artwork: {{brand}}, the marmot, and the animal avatars are original artwork made for this app.
